description: This file defines the ChartColor class, which encapsulates color properties used in chart rendering within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods to set and get color values, types, alpha transparency, brightness, and related properties, including utility functions for XML serialization of alpha values.

classes.name: ChartColor
classes.description: A class representing a color definition used in chart elements, supporting color types, alpha transparency, brightness, and conversion utilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing initialization with color value array or properties.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the color value as a string.

methods.name: setColorProperties
methods.description: Sets multiple color properties including color value, alpha, type, and brightness.

methods.name: setColorPropertiesArray
methods.description: Sets color properties from an associative array.

methods.name: isUsable
methods.description: Determines if the color object is usable based on type and value.

methods.name: getColorProperty
methods.description: Retrieves specific color property by name.

methods.name: alphaToXml
methods.description: Converts an alpha integer value to XML string format.

methods.name: alphaFromXml
methods.description: Converts an XML alpha string to an integer value.
